create_Lfm2Config: create an Lfm2Config instance with default model hyperparameters for the LFM2 architecture
build_Lfm2Config_conv_params: build an Lfm2Config with custom conv_bias and conv_L_cache settings for conv layer configuration
configure_Lfm2Config_attention_layers: configure Lfm2Config with full_attn_idxs to control which layers use full attention versus conv
initialize_Lfm2Config_from_checkpoint: initialize Lfm2Config from the LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B checkpoint with preset model hyperparameters
set_Lfm2Config_ffn_dimensions: set Lfm2Config intermediate_size using block_ffn_dim_multiplier and block_multiple_of parameters
